cursorLocal.summary: The local Cursor install (~/.cursor/) holds real migratable config in exactly four places: mcp.json (5 MCP servers, no secrets present), cli-config.json (CLI permissions/approval/sandbox/attribution prefs), hooks.json (one preToolUse hook installed by the impeccable skill), and skills/ (one personal skill, impeccable v3.8.0). Cursor-native global rules are effectively unused on this machine: ~/.cursor/rules/, ~/.cursor/commands/, ~/.cursor/AGENTS.md are absent, the IDE-level "User Rules" (aicontext.personalContext in state.vscdb) is empty, and no project-level .cursor/ directory exists anywhere under Documents/Desktop/Downloads — the user's real global rules live in ~/.agent-rules.md shared by Claude/Codex, and recent projects use root AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md instead. skills-cursor/ (24 dirs) is Cursor-managed builtin content with sync manifests and must not be migrated; agents/ exists but is empty. Cursor's hooks schema (single hooks.json, version:1, camelCase events, flat hook objects with command/type/timeout/matcher/failClosed) is similar in spirit but not drop-in compatible with Claude Code's settings.json hooks (PascalCase events, nested matcher+hooks array, different stdout JSON contract); only the exit-code-2-blocks convention matches. IDE-level settings.json/keybindings.json are almost entirely VS Code/Cursor IDE-only (workbench, explorer, git, remote.SSH, composerMode keybinding); nothing there maps to Claude Code CLI. Remaining dirs (projects/, plans/, snapshots/, ai-tracking/, context-mode/, extensions/, ide_state.json, argv.json) are session data, plan-mode documents, or telemetry — plans/*.plan.md are the only ones worth optionally carrying over as documents.

facts.detail: No Cursor-native global rules exist: ~/.cursor/rules/ (reserved per the CURSOR MANAGED .gitignore block as 'User-level cursor rules'), ~/.cursor/commands/, ~/.cursor/subagents/, ~/.cursor/AGENTS.md, and ~/.cursor/chats/ are all absent. The IDE 'User Rules' value (key aicontext.personalContext in state.vscdb ItemTable) has length 0 (empty). The user's effective global rules live outside Cursor in ~/.agent-rules.md (shared by ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md and ~/.codex/AGENTS.md).

Cursor project rules are .cursor/rules/*.mdc files with YAML frontmatter fields description (string), globs (string pattern), alwaysApply (boolean), followed by markdown body. However, a find to depth 5 over ~/Documents, ~/Desktop, ~/Downloads found ZERO project-level .cursor/ directories — recent projects (e.g. internkim) use root-level AGENTS.md + CLAUDE.md instead.

~/.cursor/mcp.json (mode 0600, 524B). Shape: {"mcpServers": {"<name>": {"command": "npx", "args": [...]}} for stdio, or {"url": "https://...", "headers": {}} for HTTP}. Five servers: context7 (npx -y @upstash/context7-mcp@latest), 'Figma Desktop' (url http://127.0.0.1:3845/mcp), Notion (url https://mcp.notion.com/mcp), Playwright (single-string command "npx @playwright/mcp@latest" — command+args merged into one string, a Cursor-tolerated variant), supabase (url https://mcp.supabase.com/mcp?project_ref=<redacted-project-ref>). All headers objects are empty — NO API keys/tokens present anywhere in the file. Server names may contain spaces ('Figma Desktop').

~/.cursor/skills/ holds user-personal skills; exactly one: impeccable (v3.8.0, Apache 2.0). Layout: impeccable/SKILL.md + scripts/ (~30 .mjs/.js files incl. hook-before-edit.mjs, context.mjs, palette.mjs, live-*.mjs) + reference/ (~28 .md sub-command references: craft, shape, audit, polish, brand, product, init, ...). SKILL.md frontmatter: name, description, version, license — same agent-skills SKILL.md format Claude Code uses, so it is directly migratable to ~/.claude/skills/ (note: its scripts hardcode relative path 'node .cursor/skills/impeccable/scripts/...' which would need rewriting to .claude paths).

~/.cursor/skills-cursor/ holds 24 Cursor-managed builtin skill dirs (automate, autopilot, canvas, create-hook, create-rule, create-skill, create-subagent, loop, migrate-to-skills, new-repo, onboard, origin, rename-chat, review, review-bugbot, review-security, sdk, share, shell, split-to-prs, statusline, update-cli-config, update-cursor-settings) plus two manifests: .cursor-managed-skills-manifest.json ({builtinSkillIds:[...], managedSkillIds:["babysit","canvas","cursor-blame"]}) and .sync-manifest.json ({version:1, skills:{<id>:{lastSyncedAt:<epoch-ms>}}, lastInventoryAt}). These are product-synced (lastSyncedAt 2026-08-19) and Cursor-specific (canvas SKILL.md adds frontmatter metadata.surfaces:[ide,cloud] and environments:[local,cloud]; shell/create-subagent add disable-model-invocation: true). Difference vs skills/: skills-cursor = shipped+auto-resynced by Cursor, skills = user-owned; only skills/ should migrate.

~/.cursor/agents/ exists but is EMPTY (nothing to migrate). Documented format (from builtin create-subagent skill): one .md file per subagent with YAML frontmatter (required: name — lowercase+hyphens, description) and markdown body = the system prompt. Project .cursor/agents/ takes priority over user ~/.cursor/agents/. This maps 1:1 onto Claude Code's ~/.claude/agents/ *.md format.

~/.cursor/hooks.json exact content: {"version":1,"hooks":{"preToolUse":[{"command":"node \".cursor/skills/impeccable/scripts/hook-before-edit.mjs\"","timeout":5}]}} — one hook installed by the impeccable skill (script exists at ~/.cursor/skills/impeccable/scripts/hook-before-edit.mjs; the relative '.cursor/...' path is project-root-style even though user hooks run from ~/.cursor/, an installer quirk worth normalizing during migration). Cursor schema: standalone hooks.json with version:1; camelCase events (sessionStart, sessionEnd, preToolUse, postToolUse, postToolUseFailure, subagentStart/Stop, beforeShellExecution, afterShellExecution, beforeMCPExecution, afterMCPExecution, beforeReadFile, afterFileEdit, beforeSubmitPrompt, preCompact, stop, afterAgentResponse, afterAgentThought, plus Tab events); each event maps to a FLAT array of {command, type:"command"|"prompt", prompt, timeout(seconds), matcher(JS regex string), failClosed, loop_limit}. NOT the same as Claude Code's schema: Claude Code stores hooks inside settings.json with PascalCase events (PreToolUse...) and nested [{matcher, hooks:[{type,command,timeout}]}], and stdout contracts differ (Cursor returns permission/user_message/agent_message/updated_input/additional_context/followup_message; Claude Code uses its own decision fields). Shared convention: exit code 2 blocks the action; other non-zero fails open unless failClosed. Migration requires event-name mapping + payload-contract translation, not a copy.

Full contents (nothing secret): {version:1, editor:{vimMode:false}, hasChangedDefaultModel:false, permissions:{allow:["Shell(ls)"], deny:[]}, approvalMode:"allowlist", sandbox:{mode:"disabled", networkAccess:"allowlist"}, network:{useHttp1ForAgent:false}, attribution:{attributeCommitsToAgent:true, attributePRsToAgent:true}}. Holds Cursor CLI agent preferences: permission allowlist (Shell(ls) maps to Claude Code's Bash(ls:*)), approval mode, sandbox policy, commit/PR attribution. Per the builtin statusline skill, this file also accepts a statusLine entry whose spec is explicitly aligned with Claude Code's statusline (JSON on stdin, stdout rendered), so a statusline would port directly — none is configured here.

~/.cursor/plans/ holds 7 Cursor plan-mode artifacts, Korean-titled *.plan.md files (e.g. 파트너_매칭_20739d51.plan.md). Format: YAML frontmatter {name, overview, todos:[]} + markdown body with code-location citations like ```238:291:path/file.jsx```. Portable as plain documents; no Claude Code equivalent location (could land in a project docs/ or ~/.claude scratch).

~/.cursor/projects/ has ~190 per-workspace dirs keyed by sanitized absolute path (Users-ichanhui-Documents-...) or numeric id. Sample dir contains canvases/, terminals/, mcps/; mcps/ caches per-server tool descriptors: <scope>-<server>/SERVER_METADATA.json ({serverIdentifier:"user-context7", serverName:"context7"}) + INSTRUCTIONS.md + tools/*.json. The .gitignore allowlists projects/*/mcps, agent-transcripts, terminals, agent-notes, agent-tools. Session/workspace state — not migratable settings.

cursorDocs.summary: Cursor's file-on-disk config surface (as of Aug 2026) covers rules, MCP, hooks, commands, skills, plugins, and CLI config. Rules live in `.cursor/rules/*.mdc` (frontmatter: `description`, `globs`, `alwaysApply`) with precedence Team > Project > User; `AGENTS.md` (root + subdirectories) and `CLAUDE.md` (read identically, always applied) are plain-markdown alternatives, and legacy `.cursorrules` is "legacy and will be deprecated" but still works. MCP uses `~/.cursor/mcp.json` and `.cursor/mcp.json` with an `mcpServers` map (stdio: `command`/`args`/`env`/`envFile`; remote: `url`/`headers`/optional `auth`), shared verbatim by the CLI. Hooks are a native, documented feature (`.cursor/hooks.json`, `~/.cursor/hooks.json`, schema `{"version":1,"hooks":{...}}` with ~20 events), and Cursor explicitly loads Claude Code hooks from `.claude/settings(.local).json` and `~/.claude/settings.json` with automatic event-name mapping — so a Claude Code hooks schema largely works as-is. Custom slash commands are plain markdown in `.cursor/commands/` (project) and `~/.cursor/commands/` (global); skills are `SKILL.md` folders under `.cursor/skills/`, `.agents/skills/`, `~/.cursor/skills/`, `~/.agents/skills/`, plus legacy-compat loading from `.claude/skills/` and `.codex/skills/` (project and home) — `~/.cursor/skills-cursor/` is a separate app-managed directory of Cursor's first-party built-in skills, not user config. The CLI (`agent` binary, `cursor-agent` alias) reads `~/.cursor/cli-config.json` plus project `.cursor/cli.json`, and runs the same rules, MCP servers, hooks, skills, and custom commands as the IDE — so shipping a `/migrate` command as `.cursor/commands/migrate.md` or a skill with `disable-model-invocation: true` would run inside both IDE chat and CLI with full agent file read/write ability. GUI/database-only state that cannot migrate file-to-file: User Rules stored on the Cursor account (synced), Team Rules (dashboard), Memories (Settings-managed per-project store, reportedly removed/reworked in 2.1), Custom Modes (beta local editor state, removed in 2.1), and Tab/editor settings.

facts.detail: Project rules are .mdc files in .cursor/rules/ (plain .md ignored except AGENTS.md). Frontmatter fields: description (string), globs (comma-separated glob string), alwaysApply (boolean). Four types: Always Apply (alwaysApply: true), Apply Intelligently (alwaysApply: false + description, no globs), Apply to Specific Files (globs set), Apply Manually (invoked via @rule-name). Subfolders inside .cursor/rules/ work but flat layout is recommended. Rules apply only to Agent chat, not Tab or Inline Edit. Generate with /create-rule.

facts.topic: Rules: precedence and User Rules storage
facts.detail: Conflict precedence: Team Rules > Project Rules > User Rules. User Rules created in Cursor Settings are stored on the Cursor account and sync across machines (GUI state, not a file). Additionally, user rule FILES in ~/.cursor/rules (Windows %USERPROFILE%\.cursor\rules) are supported, stay on the machine, and do not sync. Team Rules are managed from the Cursor dashboard (Team/Enterprise plans).

AGENTS.md is supported in project root and subdirectories (nested files apply contextually, child instructions take precedence); no frontmatter. CLAUDE.md is read the same way as AGENTS.md and is always applied to every conversation regardless of alwaysApply. Legacy .cursorrules in project root: 'is legacy and will be deprecated' — still supported today.

facts.topic: MCP: file locations and stdio shape
facts.detail: Global ~/.cursor/mcp.json, project .cursor/mcp.json. Top-level key mcpServers. Stdio server fields: type: "stdio", command (required), args (array), env (object), envFile (path, stdio only). Variable interpolation in command/args/env/url/headers: ${env:NAME}, ${userHome}, ${workspaceFolder}, ${workspaceFolderBasename}, ${pathSeparator} / ${/}.

Remote servers: url (required), headers (object, interpolation supported). SSE and HTTP transports are both handled from the url field. Optional auth block for static OAuth: CLIENT_ID (required), CLIENT_SECRET (optional), scopes (optional, else discovered from .well-known/oauth-authorization-server). OAuth redirect: https://www.cursor.com/agents/mcp/oauth/callback (web/cloud), http://localhost:8787/callback (desktop).

The CLI automatically detects and respects the same mcp.json configuration as the editor (project and global), with stdio/HTTP/SSE transports. Commands: agent mcp list / list-tools <id> / login <id> / enable <id> / disable <id>; /mcp slash command in interactive mode; --approve-mcps flag skips server approval prompts.

Plain markdown files: project .cursor/commands/<command>.md and global ~/.cursor/commands/. Invoked by typing / in the Agent input. Introduced in Cursor 1.6 ('Commands are stored in .cursor/commands/[command].md'). No frontmatter schema is documented for commands. Still supported, but docs now treat skills as the current paradigm; the built-in /migrate-to-skills skill (Cursor 2.4+) converts slash commands and dynamic rules to skills while preserving explicit-invocation behavior.

A skill is a folder containing SKILL.md (plus optional scripts/references/assets). Loaded from project .cursor/skills/ and .agents/skills/ (recursively anywhere in the repo — nested skills like apps/web/.cursor/skills/ are auto-scoped to that directory), global ~/.cursor/skills/ and ~/.agents/skills/, and legacy-compat .claude/skills/, .codex/skills/, ~/.claude/skills/, ~/.codex/skills/. Frontmatter: name (lowercase/numbers/hyphens, must match folder name), description; optional paths (list or comma-separated globs; supersedes legacy globs), disable-model-invocation (true = only runs when explicitly typed as /skill-name, like a slash command), metadata (arbitrary key-values). Built on the Agent Skills open standard (agentskills.io). /create-skill scaffolds new skills.

~/.cursor/skills/ is the user's own global skills directory (documented). ~/.cursor/skills-cursor/ is an app-managed directory where Cursor stores its first-party/built-in managed skills (e.g., create-skill, migrate-to-skills); it is not documented as a user config surface and should not be migrated into — user content belongs in ~/.cursor/skills/. The skills-cursor behavior is confirmed by a Cursor forum feedback thread, not by official docs.

Plugins bundle rules (.mdc), skills, agents, commands, MCP servers, and hooks. Two manifest formats: Agent Plugins open standard — root plugin.json with schema https://agent-plugins.org/schemas/1.0.0/plugin.schema.json; Cursor plugins — .cursor-plugin/plugin.json (plus optional .cursor-plugin/marketplace.json for multi-plugin repos). Minimal fields: name, plus optional description, version, author. Local development install: ~/.cursor/plugins/local/<my-plugin>/ (symlinks supported). Distribution via cursor.com/marketplace and team marketplaces. The CLI has a /plugin command; plugin skills, slash commands, subagents, and MCP servers load into CLI sessions.

hooks.json at four levels, priority Enterprise (MDM) > Team (cloud) > Project (.cursor/hooks.json) > User (~/.cursor/hooks.json). Schema: {"version": 1, "hooks": {"<event>": [{"command": "./script.sh", "type": "command"|"prompt", "timeout": seconds, "loop_limit": n|null, "failClosed": bool, "matcher": "pattern"}]}}. Communication is JSON over stdin/stdout; control-flow hooks return {"permission": "allow"|"deny"|"ask", "user_message", "agent_message"}. Exit code 0 = use JSON output, 2 = block (deny), other = fail-open. Env vars provided: CURSOR_PROJECT_DIR, CURSOR_VERSION, CURSOR_USER_EMAIL, CURSOR_TRANSCRIPT_PATH, CURSOR_CODE_REMOTE, and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR as a compatibility alias. Hooks run in both the desktop app and CLI.

Agent events: sessionStart, sessionEnd, preToolUse, postToolUse, postToolUseFailure, subagentStart, subagentStop, beforeShellExecution, afterShellExecution, beforeMCPExecution, afterMCPExecution, beforeReadFile, afterFileEdit, beforeSubmitPrompt, preCompact, stop, afterAgentResponse, afterAgentThought. Tab events: beforeTabFileRead, afterTabFileEdit. App lifecycle: workspaceOpen (can return pluginPaths for dynamic plugin loading). stop/subagentStop can return followup_message (loop_limit default 5). Matchers filter by tool type (Shell, Read, Write, MCP:<tool_name>), subagent type, or command pattern.

Cursor natively loads Claude Code hooks from three files, priority order: .claude/settings.local.json (project-local, gitignored), .claude/settings.json (project), ~/.claude/settings.json (user). Event mapping is automatic: PreToolUse→preToolUse, PostToolUse→postToolUse, UserPromptSubmit→beforeSubmitPrompt, Stop→stop, SubagentStop→subagentStop, SessionStart→sessionStart, SessionEnd→sessionEnd, PreCompact→preCompact. Claude Code's nested schema ({matcher, hooks: [{type: "command", command}]}) and hookSpecificOutput responses are accepted (permissionDecision→permission, permissionDecisionReason→user_message; Stop decision:"block"+reason→follow-up). Not supported: Notification and PermissionRequest events; tool-matcher gaps for Glob/WebFetch/WebSearch. loop_limit default is null for Claude Code hooks vs 5 for native Cursor hooks.

Binary is `agent` (installed via curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash); `cursor-agent` remains a backward-compatible alias. Global config: ~/.cursor/cli-config.json (Windows %USERPROFILE%\.cursor\cli-config.json; overridable via CURSOR_CONFIG_DIR, or $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/cursor/cli-config.json on Linux/BSD). Fields: version (1), editor.vimMode, permissions.allow / permissions.deny (strings like "Shell(ls)"), model, approvalMode (allowlist|auto-review|unrestricted), sandbox.mode, sandbox.networkAccess, display.*, attribution.*, network.useHttp1ForAgent. Project-level: .cursor/cli.json (permissions only). Pure JSON, no comments; CLI self-repairs and backs up corrupted files as .bad.

facts.topic: CLI: shared surfaces and custom /commands + skills
facts.detail: The CLI reads the same .cursor/rules, AGENTS.md, and CLAUDE.md as the IDE, the same mcp.json, and runs hooks. Skills are 'available in both editor and CLI' (Cursor 2.4 changelog) with interactive /skills, /rules, and /commands browsers in the CLI; a /commands command creates/edits custom commands, /add-dir refreshes slash skills and custom commands live, and custom slash commands are also exposed over ACP. Built-in CLI slash commands include /model, /plan, /ask, /debug, /shell, /clear, /resume, /fork, /rewind, /summarize, /mcp, /plugin, /sandbox, /vim, /config, /help, etc.

Feasible in both IDE chat and CLI, file-based: (a) drop a plain-markdown prompt at .cursor/commands/migrate.md (project) or ~/.cursor/commands/migrate.md (global) — typing /migrate injects it into the Agent, which has file read/write and shell tool access subject to permissions; or (b) ship a skill at .cursor/skills/migrate/SKILL.md with frontmatter name: migrate, description: ..., disable-model-invocation: true so it only fires on explicit /migrate, and it can bundle helper scripts in the skill folder. Both are discovered by the IDE and the CLI; a plugin (.cursor-plugin/plugin.json) can package the same command/skill for marketplace distribution.

(1) User Rules from Settings → Rules: stored on the Cursor account, synced — not a local file (the separate ~/.cursor/rules file mechanism is local-only). (2) Team Rules: Cursor dashboard, cloud-enforced. (3) Memories: auto-generated per-project rules managed in Settings (beta, originally Settings → Rules); stored in editor state/account, never as project files; forum reports indicate the feature was removed/reworked around Cursor 2.1 (Jan 2026). (4) Custom Modes: beta GUI feature (Settings → Chat → Custom Modes) stored in local editor state, removed in Cursor 2.1.0. (5) Tab/inline-completion settings, model selection, and MCP server enable/disable toggles live in Cursor's GUI settings store (VS Code-style settings/state DB), not in .cursor files. These require manual re-entry or export via the GUI rather than file copying.

grok.summary: As of August 2026 there are two Grok coding CLIs that matter: xAI's official "Grok Build" (github.com/xai-org/grok-build, Rust, announced 2026-05-25, ~25.7k stars, pushed 2026-08-19, curl-script install) and the community superagent-ai/grok-cli (npm package "grok-dev", ~3.4k stars, last npm publish 1.1.7 on 2026-05-15, repo pushed 2026-07-06). Grok Build is clearly dominant and is the far richer target: config in ~/.grok/config.toml and project .grok/config.toml (TOML), [mcp_servers.*] tables plus compat reads of .mcp.json/.claude.json/.cursor/mcp.json, JSON+TOML hooks with PreToolUse-style events, and skills at .grok/skills/<name>/SKILL.md or ~/.grok/skills/ where `user-invocable: true` frontmatter exposes the skill as a slash command — so a custom /migrate command is directly feasible (qualified as /local:migrate or /user:migrate on collision), and the agent has full file-edit/shell tools. Grok Build reads AGENTS.md natively (candidate list: Agents.md, Claude.md, CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, AGENT.md, AGENTS.md — notably NO GROK.md anywhere) plus .grok/rules/*.md, ~/.grok/rules/, and .claude/.cursor rules compat. The superagent CLI stores settings in ~/.grok/user-settings.json and project .grok/settings.json (JSON), reads global ~/.grok/AGENTS.md plus AGENTS.md merged git-root→cwd with per-dir AGENTS.override.md (its old GROK.md support was removed in 1.0.0-rc3, 2026-03-22), has hooks (user settings only) and MCP under mcp.servers, and has readFile/writeFile/editFile/bash/grep tools — but its slash menu is a hardcoded built-in list, so no custom /migrate command; a model-invoked skill (.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, name+description frontmatter only) or a paste-in runbook is the entry-point fallback there. Both CLIs keep API keys out of instruction files: Grok Build uses XAI_API_KEY / ~/.grok/auth.json / per-model env_key fields, superagent uses GROK_API_KEY / apiKey field in ~/.grok/user-settings.json.

facts.detail: xAI's official CLI is 'Grok Build', announced 2026-05-25 for SuperGrok / X Premium Plus subscribers. Terminal TUI coding agent, plan mode, up to 8 parallel subagents, headless -p mode, ACP support; announcement states 'AGENTS.md, plugins, hooks, skills, and MCP servers all work out of the box'.

Repo github.com/xai-org/grok-build, Rust, Apache-2.0, ~25.7k stars, pushed 2026-08-19 (actively maintained, synced from internal monorepo). Install: curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash (macOS/Linux) or irm https://x.ai/cli/install.ps1 | iex (Windows). Binary/command is `grok`. Docs at docs.x.ai/build/overview and in-repo at crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager/docs/user-guide/.

Global: ~/.grok/config.toml (main, TOML), ~/.grok/pager.toml (TUI), ~/.grok/auth.json (credentials, auto-managed), ~/.grok/rules/, ~/.grok/skills/, ~/.grok/plugins/, ~/.grok/agents/, ~/.grok/memory/, ~/.grok/sessions/. Project: .grok/config.toml, .grok/skills/, .grok/plugins/, .grok/agents/, .grok/hooks/, .grok/sandbox.toml. Precedence: CLI flags > env vars > requirements.toml/MDM > GROK_CONFIG overlay > config.toml > managed_config.toml > defaults. `grok inspect` dumps all discovered config/instructions/skills/hooks/MCP.

Reads AGENTS.md natively. Exact filename candidates: Agents.md, Claude.md, CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, AGENT.md, AGENTS.md — GROK.md is NOT among them. Loaded from repo root down to cwd (deeper dirs win). Also always scans <dir>/.grok/rules/*.md; compat scans .claude/rules/*.md and .cursor/rules/*.md (toggles compat.claude.rules / compat.cursor.rules). Global rules live in ~/.grok/rules/ ($GROK_HOME/rules/) — a directory, not a single global md file. Session overrides: --rules (append), --system-prompt-override (replace).

TOML tables [mcp_servers.<name>] in ~/.grok/config.toml or .grok/config.toml (project wins): stdio uses command/args/env; remote uses url/headers (supports {{session_id}} templating); other keys: enabled, startup_timeout_sec, tool_timeout_sec, tool_timeouts. Compat: also reads .claude.json, .cursor/mcp.json, and .mcp.json. CLI: grok mcp list / add <name> -- <cmd> / add --transport http <name> <url> / remove / doctor. Tools namespaced server__tool. MCP OAuth creds at ~/.grok/mcp_credentials.json.

facts.topic: Grok Build: custom slash commands via skills — /migrate feasible
facts.detail: Custom slash commands are implemented as skills: a directory with SKILL.md (YAML frontmatter: name, description; optional user-invocable [default true], disable-model-invocation, allowed-tools, argument-hint, model, effort). Any enabled skill with user-invocable shows up as a slash command, e.g. .grok/skills/migrate/SKILL.md → /migrate with args as trailing text; name collisions qualified as /local:migrate (project) or /user:migrate (user). Skill search paths: ./.grok/skills/ > <repo_root>/.grok/skills/ > ~/.grok/skills/, plus compat .claude/skills/, .cursor/skills/, ~/.agents/skills/, plugin skills/, and [skills] paths in config.toml. /create-skill scaffolds one. Agent has file-edit + shell-exec tools, so an AI-driven migration can run inside it.

Events: SessionStart, SessionEnd, UserPromptSubmit, Stop, StopFailure, StopCancelled, PreToolUse, PostToolUse, PostToolUseFailure, PermissionDenied, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, Notification, PreCompact, PostCompact. Config: ~/.grok/hooks/*.json and ~/.grok/config.toml (global, no trust needed); .grok/hooks/*.json and .grok/config.toml (project, requires /hooks-trust or --trust); managed_config.toml; plugins. JSON shape mirrors Claude Code: {"hooks": {"PreToolUse": [{"matcher": "Bash", "hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "...", "timeout": 10}]}]}}; types command|http; stdin JSON envelope; stdout {"decision": "allow|deny|block", "reason", "updatedInput"}; exit 2 = deny/block; env vars GROK_HOOK_EVENT, GROK_SESSION_ID, GROK_WORKSPACE_ROOT / CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR.

Auth via browser login or XAI_API_KEY env var; tokens stored in ~/.grok/auth.json (auto-managed — location only). Models in config.toml: [models] default / web_search; custom models as [model.<name>] with fields model, base_url, name, api_key, env_key, temperature, top_p, max_completion_tokens, context_window. Credential resolution: api_key > env_key > session token > XAI_API_KEY. Switch with /model <name> or -m flag. Default model era: grok-build-0.1 / grok-4.x.

Community CLI, github.com/superagent-ai/grok-cli, ~3.4k stars, repo pushed 2026-07-06. npm package renamed from @vibe-kit/grok-cli (last publish 0.0.34 on 2025-11-27, not deprecated) to grok-dev (latest 1.1.7, published 2026-05-15). Install: bun add -g grok-dev or curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/superagent-ai/grok-cli/main/install.sh | bash. Maintained but slower since Grok Build launched; clearly secondary now.

User settings: ~/.grok/user-settings.json (JSON; fields incl. apiKey, defaultModel, sandboxMode, subAgents, hooks, mcp.servers, telegram). Project settings: .grok/settings.json in cwd. Instructions (verified in src/utils/instructions.ts): global ~/.grok/AGENTS.md, then AGENTS.md merged from git root down to cwd; AGENTS.override.md in a directory replaces that directory's AGENTS.md. GROK.md support (~/.grok/GROK.md, .grok/GROK.md) was REMOVED in v1.0.0-rc3 (2026-03-22) per CHANGELOG — current code reads only AGENTS.md. So yes, it reads AGENTS.md natively.

MCP: managed via /mcp in TUI; stored in ~/.grok/user-settings.json under mcp.servers (code: loadMcpServers → loadUserSettings().mcp?.servers). McpServerConfig fields: id, label, enabled, transport ('stdio' or remote), url, headers, command, args, env, cwd. Note README loosely says '.grok/settings.json (mcpServers)' but source reads user settings mcp.servers — README/code discrepancy. Hooks: v1.1.5 added 'Programmable hooks system with 17 lifecycle events' (PreToolUse, PostToolUse, UserPromptSubmit, SessionStart, SessionEnd, ...); configured ONLY in ~/.grok/user-settings.json under hooks (src/hooks/config.ts comment: project-level .grok/settings.json hooks intentionally excluded for security); JSON stdin/stdout, exit 2 blocks.

facts.topic: superagent-ai/grok-cli: entry-point feasibility — NO custom slash commands
facts.detail: Slash menu is a hardcoded static list in src/ui/slash-menu.ts (exit, help, remote-control, agents, schedule, mcp, sandbox, wallet, models, recaps, new, commit-push, commit-pr, review, verify, skills, btw, update) — no mechanism to register /migrate. Skills exist at .agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md (project) and ~/.agents/skills/ (user), but src/utils/skills.ts parses only name+description frontmatter and advertises skills to the model, which reads SKILL.md via read_file when relevant — model-invoked only, /skills just lists them. So the entry point is either a 'migrate' skill triggered by natural language, or the paste-in runbook prompt fallback. The agent DOES have file tools for a migration: readFile/writeFile/editFile (src/tools/file.ts), bash.ts, grep.ts. Headless: --prompt/-p.

Remaining hits are forks of the old @vibe-kit codebase (Kiryoko/grok-code, basilisk001/grok-cli, maxgoff/super-agent-grok-cli) or small projects (groking-cli, @webdevtoday/grok-cli) — none widely used. Multi-provider CLIs (OpenCode, Kilo CLI, Crush) can use Grok models but are not Grok CLIs. Dominance verdict: xai-org/grok-build (25.7k stars in ~3 months, official, actively pushed) is the primary target; superagent-ai/grok-cli is the only community CLI worth supporting.

Both relevant Grok CLIs read AGENTS.md natively. Grok Build: AGENTS.md/AGENT.md/Agents.md + CLAUDE.md family, repo root→cwd, deeper wins. superagent grok-cli: ~/.grok/AGENTS.md global + AGENTS.md git-root→cwd chain + AGENTS.override.md. Neither reads GROK.md in current versions — a migration should target AGENTS.md, not GROK.md.

gapfills.summary: Codex CLI의 훅 이벤트 11개(SessionStart, SessionEnd, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, PreCompact, PostCompact, UserPromptSubmit, Stop)는 모두 Claude Code에 동일한 이름으로 존재하므로 훅 이벤트명 자체는 1:1 무변환 매핑이 가능하고, 반대 방향으로는 Claude 전용 이벤트 약 20개(Notification, PermissionDenied, PostToolUseFailure, WorktreeCreate, ConfigChange, FileChanged, Setup 등)가 Codex에 등가물이 없어 드롭 대상이다. 매처는 이벤트명이 아니라 도구명 관례가 다르다. Codex는 shell 계열을 Bash로 정규화하고 파일 편집은 apply_patch(별칭 Edit/Write)로 받으며 Read/Grep/Glob 같은 1급 도구가 없고, 실제 로컬 파일들도 이 차이를 방어적 regex로 흡수하고 있다. 키바인딩은 Codex가 flat array [{command, key}](예: Alt+V), Claude가 context-scoped bindings 객체(예: "ctrl+e": "chat:externalEditor", chord·null unbind 지원)로 구조와 명령 네임스페이스가 전혀 달라 자동 이관은 공통 명령 매핑 테이블 없이는 불가하다. 플러그인 패키징은 양쪽이 거의 대칭이다. Claude는 .claude-plugin/plugin.json(name만 필수)+marketplace.json(name/owner/plugins[], plugins 항목은 name+source 필수), Codex는 .codex-plugin/plugin.json(name/version/description 필수, interface 메타데이터 추가)이며, Codex는 legacy로 .claude-plugin/marketplace.json을 직접 읽어 Claude 마켓플레이스(anthropics/claude-plugins-official.git)를 그대로 설치한다는 것이 로컬 config.toml로 실증된다. Codex /import는 공식 문서 기준 settings.json→config.toml, CLAUDE.md→AGENTS.md, slash command→skill, subagent→Codex agent, hooks→Codex hooks(동기 command 훅만), MCP JSON→TOML snake_case 변환을 하며 ConfigChange 훅·output style 등 미지원 항목은 스킵한다 — 역방향 도구의 참조 매핑으로 쓸 수 있다.

facts.detail: 공식 문서 기준 11개: SessionStart, SessionEnd, SubagentStart, SubagentStop, PreToolUse, PermissionRequest, PostToolUse, PreCompact, PostCompact, UserPromptSubmit, Stop. matcher 지원: PreToolUse/PermissionRequest/PostToolUse=도구명, SubagentStart/Stop=subagent type, SessionStart=시작 source(startup|resume|clear|compact), SessionEnd=종료 reason(현재 other만), Pre/PostCompact=manual|auto. UserPromptSubmit·Stop은 matcher 무시.

facts.topic: Claude Code 훅 이벤트 전체 목록
facts.detail: Codex 11개와 동명 이벤트 전부 포함 + Claude 전용: Setup, UserPromptExpansion, StopFailure, PermissionDenied, PostToolUseFailure, PostToolBatch, TeammateIdle, TaskCreated, TaskCompleted, InstructionsLoaded, ConfigChange, CwdChanged, DirectoryAdded, FileChanged, WorktreeCreate, WorktreeRemove, Elicitation, ElicitationResult, Notification, MessageDisplay. SessionStart matcher에 Claude만 fork 추가, SessionEnd reason도 Claude가 더 세분화(clear|resume|logout|prompt_input_exit|other).

Codex→Claude: 11개 전부 identical(개명 없음, no-equivalent 없음). Claude→Codex: 위 Claude 전용 이벤트 전부 no-equivalent(드롭 또는 경고 대상). renamed 카테고리는 양방향 모두 공집합. 주의: Claude PostToolUseFailure/PermissionDenied는 Codex PostToolUse/PermissionRequest로 접지 못함(별개 시맨틱).

Codex 정식 매처: Bash(shell·unified exec 정규화), apply_patch(별칭 Edit/Write 허용, 단 hook input의 tool_name은 항상 "apply_patch"), mcp__server__tool, 로컬 function tool은 함수명(update_plan 등, spawn_agent는 Agent로 매칭). Claude 정식 매처: Bash, PowerShell, Edit, Write, Read, Grep, Glob, NotebookEdit, mcp__server__tool. Codex에는 Read/Grep/Glob 1급 도구가 없어 Claude→Codex 이관 시 해당 매처는 사실상 dead pattern.

~/.codex/hooks.json PreToolUse matcher: "Bash|Shell|shell|local_shell|shell_command|exec_command|apply_patch|Read|Edit|Write|Grep|read_file|grep_files|mcp__.*" (Codex 도구명 변형을 방어적으로 전부 나열). 같은 훅의 ~/.claude/settings.json 버전: "Bash|Grep|Read|Edit|Write|NotebookEdit|mcp__.*". PostToolUse는 Codex "Edit|Write|apply_patch" vs Claude 쪽 "Edit|Write" 패턴이 대응.

양쪽 모두 {"hooks": {Event: [{matcher, hooks: [{type:"command", command, timeout, statusMessage}]}]}} 동일 JSON 구조. Codex 파일 위치: ~/.codex/hooks.json, <repo>/.codex/hooks.json, config.toml 인라인 [[hooks.Event]] 테이블, 플러그인 hooks/hooks.json(기본 timeout 600초). Claude 위치: settings.json 계층의 hooks 키 + 플러그인 hooks/hooks.json. Claude는 command 외 http/mcp_tool/prompt/agent 훅 타입을 지원하나 Codex는 command만 — 마이그레이션 시 비-command 타입은 스킵해야 함.

facts.topic: 로컬 hooks.json의 Notification 블록 이상 징후
facts.detail: ~/.codex/hooks.json에 Notification 이벤트 블록이 존재하지만 Codex 공식 11개 이벤트 목록에는 Notification이 없음. /import가 Claude 설정을 변환하며 남긴 잔재로 보이며 Codex가 미지 이벤트를 조용히 무시하는 것으로 추정(에러 없이 로드됨).
~/.codex/keybindings.json = flat array: [{"command": "realtimeVoice", "key": "Alt+V"}]. key 표기는 대문자 modifier(Alt+V). TUI의 /keymap 명령으로 리매핑. 컨텍스트 개념 없음.

~/.claude/keybindings.json = {"$schema": "https://www.schemastore.org/claude-code-keybindings.json", "bindings": [{"context": "Chat", "bindings": {"ctrl+e": "chat:externalEditor"}}]}. 20개 컨텍스트(Global/Chat/Confirmation/...), 네임스페이스 액션 ID(chat:submit, app:interrupt 등), 소문자 key 표기, chord("ctrl+k ctrl+s") 지원, null로 기본 바인딩 해제, 사용자 바인딩은 additive. 이 머신에는 파일 미존재(기본값 사용 중).

구조 변환은 trivial하지만 명령 네임스페이스가 완전히 다름(Codex "realtimeVoice" vs Claude "chat:externalEditor"). 공유 명령 ID가 없어 자동 이관은 수작업 command 매핑 테이블이 있는 쌍에만 가능하고, 대응 없는 명령(realtimeVoice 등)은 드롭. key 표기 정규화 필요(Alt+V ↔ alt+v). Claude의 context/chord/null-unbind는 Codex에 표현 불가.

.claude-plugin/plugin.json 필수: name(kebab-case)만. 선택: displayName, version, description, author{name,email?,url?}, homepage, repository, license, keywords, metadata, defaultEnabled, $schema, 컴포넌트 경로 필드(skills[기본 skills/에 추가], commands/agents/workflows/outputStyles[기본 대체], hooks/mcpServers/lspServers[병합]), userConfig, channels, dependencies. 경로는 ./ 시작 상대경로. .claude-plugin/에는 plugin.json만 두고 컴포넌트 디렉토리는 플러그인 루트에. 루트 SKILL.md 하나면 단일 스킬 플러그인으로 자동 로드. 스킬을 플러그인으로 포장하는 최소 구성: .claude-plugin/plugin.json({"name": ...}) + skills/<name>/SKILL.md.

루트 .claude-plugin/marketplace.json. 최상위 필수: name, owner, plugins[]. 플러그인 항목 필수: name, source. 선택: displayName, version, description, author, homepage, repository, license, category, tags, strict(기본 true), defaultEnabled. source 타입: 상대경로 문자열, github:owner/repo#ref, git:url#ref, git-subdir:url/path#ref, zip URL(+sha256), npm:pkg, command:, skills-dir. 실제 공식 마켓 파일은 객체형 source({source:"git-subdir", url, path, ref, sha})와 renames 맵도 사용.

.codex-plugin/plugin.json이 유일한 필수 파일. 필수 필드: name, version, description. 선택: author, homepage, repository, license, keywords, skills("./skills/"), mcpServers("./.mcp.json"), apps("./.app.json"), hooks, interface{displayName, shortDescription, longDescription, developerName, category, capabilities[], websiteURL, privacyPolicyURL, termsOfServiceURL, defaultPrompt[], brandColor, composerIcon, logo, screenshots}. 로컬 실물 예시가 스키마와 일치(openai github 플러그인). 설치 위치는 ~/.codex/plugins/cache/<marketplace>/<plugin>/<version>/.

marketplace.json 위치: $REPO_ROOT/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json, ~/.agents/plugins/marketplace.json, legacy $REPO_ROOT/.claude-plugin/marketplace.json(Claude 호환). 항목에 source{source: local|url|git-subdir|npm, ...}와 policy{installation: AVAILABLE|INSTALLED_BY_DEFAULT|NOT_AVAILABLE, authentication: ON_INSTALL|ON_FIRST_USE}. CLI: codex plugin marketplace add owner/repo [--ref] [--sparse], list|upgrade|remove, TUI /plugins. 상태는 config.toml의 [marketplaces.<name>](source_type=git|local, source, last_revision)과 [plugins."name@marketplace"] enabled=true로 기록되고, 하위 테이블로 MCP tool별 approval_mode 오버라이드 가능.

로컬 config.toml에 [marketplaces.claude-plugins-official] source=https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official.git, [plugins."frontend-design@claude-plugins-official"] enabled=true가 있고 ~/.codex/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/{frontend-design,github,supabase}가 설치돼 있음. 즉 Claude 형식(.claude-plugin/marketplace.json + plugin.json) 마켓을 Codex가 무변환 설치 — 배포 시 Claude 플러그인 하나로 양쪽 커버 가능. superpowers, claude-mem, context-mode 등 서드파티 Claude 마켓도 동일하게 등록돼 있음.

Claude Code/Cursor 공통 지원. CLAUDE.md 계열 instruction→AGENTS.md, settings.json→config.toml, skills→Codex skills(그대로), project 폴더→매칭 디렉토리 projects, project memories→Memories, MCP 설정→[mcp_servers.*], hooks→Codex hooks, slash commands→skills로 변환, subagents→Codex agents, 세션→최근 30일·최대 50개. 실행 중 태스크·remote 세션·app-server 데몬 연결 중에는 사용 불가. import 후 커스텀 인증 MCP·동작 변형된 훅·수동 설정 필요한 플러그인 검토 권고.

facts.topic: Codex /import 세부 변환 규칙 (서드파티 상세, v0.145)
facts.detail: 추가 세부: 훅은 동기 command 훅만 변환, 비지원 형태(async, conditional group, ConfigChange 이벤트)는 스킵. permissions는 approval_policy+sandbox 계층으로 직접 매핑 불가·수동 재설계. MCP는 camelCase→snake_case, JSON→TOML 구조 보존(Cursor HTTP 서버는 mcp-proxy 필요). ~/.claude/agents/*.md→.codex/agents/*.toml(name/description/developer_instructions 키 구조화). output styles는 미지원 스킵. 기존 Codex 설정은 additive merge로 보존. 우리 역방향 도구의 대칭 참조로 유효.

~/.codex/external_agent_session_imports.json이 ~/.claude/projects/**/*.jsonl 각각을 {source_path, content_sha256, imported_thread_id, imported_at}로 기록 — 콘텐츠 해시 기반 dedupe로 재실행 시 재수입 방지. 역방향 도구도 동일한 해시 원장 패턴을 쓰는 것이 안전.
